title: Aftergraph Voice Interaction
description: EXPERIMENTAL voice-interaction contract for the Interaction Fabric realtime voice edge. A disposable voice session carries turn/observation content only: durable principal identity and durable interaction/memory/mission state live outside the session in Runtime/WORKS/consent-ledger-owned stores and are referenced, never embedded. Session admission and egress/effects pass Trust Gateway grant enforcement. Transcript is not principal identity and speaker attribution is not principal authentication (inherited Wave F pocket-source binding, not re-derived). The session confers no authority and replaces no canonical source. Turn/stop/barge-in semantics follow V4 section 14: STOP_SPEAKING/CANCEL_TURN interrupt speech/turn only while PAUSE_MISSION/CANCEL_MISSION/FREEZE_AUTONOMY require the governed consequential path (AIE -> Trust Gateway -> Runtime -> WORKS -> verification); barge-in never terminates consequential execution; session identity stays disposable and is never reused as a durable principal; realtime raw-audio streaming claims are evidence-gated on device/API evidence.

handoff_checkpoint.description: HandoffCheckpoint reference carrying cross-surface continuity; transports correlation/provenance only, never authority.

correlation_refs.description: platform-event-ref/0.1 correlation/provenance references composed by reference; possession never grants authority.

destination_readmission_ref.description: Destination Trust Gateway re-admission reference; authority is re-admitted at the destination, never transported.

authority_transport.description: True claims the handoff/session moved authority; always rejected - continuity never moves authority.

continuity_basis.description: Claimed basis of continuity; only correlation_provenance accepts. Conversation != Memory != Continuity != Authority.

purpose.description: Consent/purpose lineage attached to the voice turn/observation and propagated to derivatives.

lineage_refs.description: Explicit lineage references propagated to derivatives and required for cross-surface attribution.

revocation_ref.description: Consent revocation reference invalidating downstream voice-derived use per provenance.

downstream_invalidated.description: True records that downstream voice-derived use was invalidated per provenance after revocation.

audit_rewritten.description: True claims historical audit/evidence was rewritten; always rejected.

deletion_ref.description: Source/turn deletion reference withdrawing reads and derivatives.

withdrawn.description: True withdraws reads and derivatives; requires deletion_ref and tombstone_ref.

tombstone_ref.description: Tombstone marker for deleted turns; historical audit is preserved, never rewritten.

source_surface_ref.description: Surface where the voice content originated.

attributed_surface_ref.description: Surface where the content is attributed; differing surfaces require explicit lineage.

injection_contained.description: True records prompt-injection content in the transcript was contained as untrusted observation.
